name: Edward M.
headline: Director, Partnerships
about:
I lead the high-frequency partnership vertical at Scene+, Canada's largest loyalty program, overseeing strategic accounts with Shell and Empire — two of the country's most important fuel and grocery partners.
 
My work sits at the intersection of strategy, partner advocacy, and card acquisition — building programs that drive member engagement at scale while delivering measurable value for both Scene+ and our partners. I manage two teams and own annual account planning, KPI delivery, and cross-functional execution across both verticals.
 
I came up through Scotiabank's customer journey and retail banking teams, so I bring a financial services lens in all I do.

experiences.description:
Lead strategic partnerships teams for Scene+'s high-frequency verticals (Shell and Empire)

Act as dual advocate, internal champion for partner priorities and external face of Scene+ strategy with partners

Partner with Scotiabank on card acquisition and cardholder engagement initiatives tied to the loyalty ecosystem

experiences.position: Manager, Strategic Customer Journeys, Retail Customer Value

Data-Driven Insights: Leveraged data to identify friction points, and cross-sell opportunities across the journey.

Sales Leadership: Managed a high-performing team of advisors managing the largest Small Business portfolio in the country, utilizing coaching to consistently exceed district targets and drive long-term client retention.

Retail Network Experience: Developed a full comprehensive understanding of the retail branch network, advancing from frontline service to leadership—providing deep insight into operational execution.
